cases.translation: Out of the depths I cry to you.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Владыка, услышь мой ___, будь внимателен к моим молениям.
cases.translation: Lord, hear my voice, be attentive to my prayers.
cases.explain: Голос is the direct object of the transitive verb услышь (hear), governing the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Если бы ты, Господи, вел счет ___.
cases.translation: If you, O Lord, kept a record of sin.
cases.explain: The preposition счет (account, record) can be followed by the instrumental case.

cases.translation: But with you there is forgiveness.
cases.explain: Прощение is the predicate nominative following есть (there is), taking the nominative case.

cases.translation: On the Lord I place my hope.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on, in) followed by надеются (to hope/trust) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Надеется ___ моя, и на слово его уповаю.
cases.translation: My soul hopes, and I trust in his word.
cases.explain: Душа is the subject of the verb надеется (hopes), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Душа моя ждет ___ более чем стражи утра.
cases.translation: My soul waits for the Master more than watchmen wait for the morning.
cases.explain: Владыку is the direct object of the verb ждет (waits for), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он избавит Израиль от всех его ___.
cases.translation: He will redeem Israel from all his sins.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Изглубим взываю я к тебе, Господи.
reading.question: What does the psalmist do from the depths?
reading.explain: The text says 'Изглубим взываю я к тебе, Господи' (From the depths I cry to you, Lord).

reading.ru: Владыка, услышь мой голос, будь внимателен к моим молениям.
reading.question: What does the speaker ask the Lord to do?
options: Listen to his voice and pay attention to his prayers
reading.correct: Listen to his voice and pay attention to his prayers
reading.explain: The text explicitly requests 'услышь мой голос, будь внимателен к моим молениям' (hear my voice, be attentive to my prayers).

reading.ru: Но у тебя есть прощение, пусть боятся тебя.
reading.question: According to the psalmist, what does God have that causes fear?
reading.explain: The text states 'у тебя есть прощение, пусть боятся тебя' (with you there is forgiveness, let them fear you).

reading.ru: На Господа я надеюсь, надеется душа моя, и на слово его уповаю.
reading.question: In whom does the psalmist place his hope?
reading.explain: The text declares 'На Господа я надеюсь... и на слово его уповаю' (In God I hope... and in His word I trust).

reading.ru: Душа моя ждет владыку более чем стражи утра.
reading.question: What does the psalmist's soul wait for with great longing?
reading.explain: The text says 'Душа моя ждет владыку' (My soul waits for the Lord), emphasizing intense longing by comparing it to watchmen awaiting dawn.

reading.ru: Да уповает Израиль на Господа, потому что у Господа милость и великое избавление у него.
reading.question: Why should Israel hope in the Lord?
options: Because He has mercy and great redemption
reading.correct: Because He has mercy and great redemption
reading.explain: The text explains that Israel should trust the Lord 'потому что у Господа милость и великое избавление' (because with God there is mercy and great redemption).
